# The Council: nodes and states

Implementation planning diagrams for the approved Council design. They show proposed software, not a deployed system.

## Council component nodes

The calling agent authors candidates. The state machine selects transitions. Orca owns worker lifecycle.

<!-- mermaid:id=components -->
```mermaid
flowchart TB
  accTitle: Council component nodes
  accDescr: Three equal reviewers and one fresh judge connect through an Orca adapter to a deterministic controller and its journal.
  caller["Calling agent / candidate author"]
  class caller coord
  skill["Council skill / supervised loop"]
  class skill coord
  core["XState core / pure transitions"]
  class core coord
  journal["SQLite / events and effect intents"]
  class journal store
  evidence["Evidence adapter / allowed checks"]
  class evidence store
  orca["Orca adapter / lifecycle receipts"]
  class orca coord
  astra["Astra reviewer / Ultra"]
  class astra reviewer
  argon["Argon reviewer / High"]
  class argon reviewer
  opus["Opus reviewer / High"]
  class opus reviewer
  judge["Fresh Astra judge / Ultra"]
  class judge judge
  caller -->|input and candidate| skill
  skill -->|validated events| core
  core -->|atomic checkpoint and intents| journal
  core -->|allowed evidence requests| evidence
  core -->|launch or reconcile intents| orca
  orca -->|reviewer phase| astra
  orca -->|reviewer phase| argon
  orca -->|reviewer phase| opus
  orca -->|between reviewer phases| judge
  orca -->|validated results| core
  core -->|action request or final report| caller
classDef coord fill:#e8f1ff,stroke:#285b9a,color:#172f52
classDef store fill:#f2f4f7,stroke:#667085,color:#273142
classDef reviewer fill:#eaf7ef,stroke:#35724c,color:#194a2b
classDef judge fill:#fff2db,stroke:#9a6a17,color:#664300
%% portable-canonical-v2:
```

## Council control states

New runs start at preflight. Restored runs enter reconciling. Every decision outcome requires resource settlement.

<!-- mermaid:id=states -->
```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  accTitle: Council control states
  accDescr: The workflow collects three reviews, freezes a candidate, obtains a fresh judge report, and collects three final responses. Unanimous acceptance completes the run. The third unresolved round returns to the user.
  state "preflight" as preflight
  state "needs_context" as needs_context
  state "prepare_round" as prepare_round
  state "reviewing" as reviewing
  state "prepare_candidate" as prepare_candidate
  state "judging" as judging
  state "confirming" as confirming
  state "evaluate_round" as evaluate_round
  state "settling" as settling
  state "completed" as completed
  state "needs_user" as needs_user
  state "blocked" as blocked
  state "cancelled" as cancelled
  state "reconciling" as reconciling
  [*] --> preflight
  preflight --> needs_context: missing input
  needs_context --> preflight: context supplied
  preflight --> blocked: policy or route gap
  preflight --> prepare_round: checks pass
  prepare_round --> reviewing: admit round and launch three
  reviewing --> prepare_candidate: three reviews settled
  reviewing --> settling: same missing input / needs_user
  prepare_candidate --> judging: candidate frozen
  judging --> confirming: judge report and exit verified
  confirming --> evaluate_round: three final responses settled
  evaluate_round --> prepare_round: disagreement and rounds remain
  evaluate_round --> settling: unanimous or round limit
  settling --> completed: consensus&#59; all resources settled
  settling --> needs_user: unresolved&#59; all resources settled
  settling --> blocked: operational gap&#59; settled
  settling --> cancelled: cancel requested&#59; settled
  settling --> reconciling: lifecycle unknown
  reconciling --> settling: exit and ownership established
  needs_user --> preflight: new input and rounds authorized
  blocked --> preflight: specific remedy authorized
%% portable-canonical-v2:
```

## Global cancellation and recovery

This view summarizes transitions that apply to every active phase. It does not introduce another model role.

<!-- mermaid:id=recovery -->
```mermaid
flowchart TB
  active["Any active phase"]
  class active coord
  settling["settling / stop owned work"]
  class settling coord
  reconciling["reconciling / inspect ownership"]
  class reconciling store
  live["Same attempt proved live"]
  class live reviewer
  unknown["Unknown / keep state unknown"]
  class unknown judge
  exit["Exit proved / safe cleanup"]
  class exit reviewer
  outcome["Publish recorded outcome"]
  class outcome store
  restore["Restart / persisted checkpoint"]
  class restore store
  active -->|error, cancellation, or deadline| settling
  settling -->|missing exit proof| reconciling
  restore -->|no blind re-launch| reconciling
  reconciling -->|positive liveness| live
  live -->|reconnect&#59; preserve attempt| active
  reconciling -->|insufficient evidence| unknown
  unknown -->|observe again| reconciling
  reconciling -->|positive exit evidence| exit
  exit -->|settle and release| settling
  settling -->|all owned resources settled| outcome
classDef coord fill:#e8f1ff,stroke:#285b9a,color:#172f52
classDef store fill:#f2f4f7,stroke:#667085,color:#273142
classDef reviewer fill:#eaf7ef,stroke:#35724c,color:#194a2b
classDef judge fill:#fff2db,stroke:#9a6a17,color:#664300
%% portable-canonical-v2:
```
